thread:
li: Heads-up — I pulled Mistral-2-small through the AWQ int4 pipeline and seeing a consistent quality regression on summarization + weird tokenizer artifacts at long ctx.

sam: numbers please? :eyes:

li: quick numbers: fp16 baseline rougeL=36.2, int4 bundle rougeL=31.9. ppl on longctx-2k set jumps 12.4 -> 19.7.

li: repro commands:
li: ```bash
li: redwood-quantize --model mistral-2-small --out m2s-int4 --scheme awq
li: redwood-pack-bundle --model m2s-int4 --out bundle-m2s-int4.tar
li: redwood-bench --bundle bundle-m2s-int4.tar --task summarization --dataset summ-test-100 --max-tokens 2048
li: ```

maria: any tokenizer diffs? special tokens, token counts, eos placement?

li: yes — when diffing token ids between fp16 and the quantized runtime I see ~8% samples with an off-by-one around EOS. Also some examples show an extra sentinel token around 1024.

priya: could be a tokenizer file mismatch (cached file / wrong variant). Did the packaging step touch tokenizer files?

li: packaging writes a parallel tokenizer_<commit>.json into the bundle. The runtime loader naively picks the first tokenizer*.json found in the bundle dir. If the bundle cache contained a stale tokenizer file from previous onboarding work, it can get picked nondeterministically.

li: minimal diff I grabbed:
li: ```
li: - 28700: "\u2581the"
li: + 28700: "\u2581the"
li: - 28705: "</s>"
li: + 28705: "<pad>"
li: ```

maria: that's EOS vs PAD swapped. explains the rouge + ppl collapse.

eva: ugh. loader order + multiple tokenizer files -> special token id swap. we've seen cache-key mixups before.

sam: mitigation plan?

li: quick: add loader validation on startup — check that the loaded tokenizer has expected special token ids from model.index.json and abort if mismatch. long term: canonicalize filename to tokenizer.json, and ensure model.index.json contains explicit tokenizer path and we prefer that.

priya: add a post-quant token-alignment gate in the pipeline: after quantization run token-id comparison vs fp16 on a 1k sample set; fail the job if >0.5% special-token disagreements or any EOS/PAD mismatches.

li: I tested swapping the canonical tokenizer back into the int4 bundle and re-ran the bench: rougeL=35.9, ppl=12.8 — basically back to fp16 aside from small quant noise.

sam: please open PR + add unit test: create a tar with two tokenizer files and assert loader picks the one referenced in model.index.json. Also a migration script to purge stale tokenizer_* artifacts from the cache and bundles.

li: PR draft: https://git.internal/redwood/packaging/pull/432 (includes failing test + fix). deploy-bot: CI queued for PR 432 — estimated run 18m.

maria: can we add a short triage playbook in docs for EOS/PAD swaps and a checklist item in the onboarding guide? new folks keep hitting this.

priya: I'll draft the playbook + add the gate to onboarding checklist.

li: TL;DR — int4 regression traced to nondeterministic tokenizer selection in bundle cache -> EOS/PAD id swap -> large long-ctx PPL and summarization drop. Fix = loader special-token validation + canonical tokenizer naming + pre/post-quant token-alignment test + cache scrub migration.

sam: solid catch li. :thumbsup:
